comparison_semantics: QID+literal Wikidata statement GUID; current-QID list is the existing scoped binding artifact; presence of QID binding does not establish historical continuity, source independence, or population grain.
limitations: Raw cache is a selected set of 1,450 full entities, not a complete Wikidata dump.
These Wikidata P1082 statements are secondary and share source lineage with other Wikidata/Wikipedia extracts.
P585 year prefixes are not census-year assignments; no Jan 1 exact dates were derived.
A current QID binding does not assert that the historical QID denotes the same place or population grain.
No values were admitted to the canonical long table and no annual national coverage claim is made.
